cards.text: Ahab, king of Israel, has ordered Micaiah, a prophet of the LORD, locked up until Ahab gets back safely. Micaiah's answer: "If you ever return safely, the LORD has not spoken through me." So Ahab and Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, march up to Ramoth-gilead anyway.

cards.question: Right before the battle, Ahab tells Jehoshaphat what each king will wear. What's the plan?

answers.text: Ahab goes disguised and Jehoshaphat wears royal robes
Both kings go into battle in disguise
Both kings go into battle in royal robes

cards.text: So the king of Israel disguises himself and goes into battle. Friend, if a buddy ever tells me, 'I'll blend in, YOU wear the fancy outfit,' I'm asking some QUESTIONS.

cards.question: Over on the other side, the king of Aram orders his thirty-two chariot commanders to fight no one, small or great, except the king of ___.
The chariot commanders spot Jehoshaphat in his royal robes and decide he must be the king of Israel.

cards.text: So the chariot commanders turn to fight Jehoshaphat. I spent YEARS in a junk drawer and nobody came looking for me, and this man puts on one nice outfit and the whole battlefield wants a word.

cards.question: With the chariot commanders coming at him, what does Jehoshaphat do?
Once the chariot commanders see Jehoshaphat isn't the king of Israel, they keep chasing him anyway.

cards.text: Ahab's still out there in his disguise. Then a certain man draws his bow, and he doesn't even take special aim.

cards.question: That man shoots without taking special aim. Who does his arrow strike?

cards.text: Right between the joints of his armor. Friend, that's like tossing your keys over your shoulder without looking, and they land RIGHT on the hook.

cards.question: Badly wounded, Ahab tells his charioteer to turn around and take him out of the battle.

cards.text: But the battle rages all that day, and Ahab is propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. The blood from his wound runs out onto the floor of the chariot.

cards.question: Propped up in his chariot, the king of Israel ___ that evening.

cards.text: The sun is going down on a long, long day. And a cry rings out in the army.

cards.question: As the sun sets, the cry in the army tells every man to go back to his own city and his own land.

cards.text: So the king dies and is brought to Samaria, where they bury him. They wash his chariot at the pool of Samaria, and the dogs lick up Ahab's blood.

cards.question: The dogs lick up Ahab's blood at the pool of Samaria. And it happens just like what?

answers.text: The word the LORD had spoken
An order from the king of Aram

cards.text: The rest of what Ahab did, the ivory palace and all the cities he built, is written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel. Then Ahab rests with his fathers.

cards.question: Ahab rests with his fathers. Who reigns in his place?
